delete.description:
Delete the local copies of fetched messages (local files only — nothing in
Gmail or in already-imported bundles is touched).
Stop after the message currently being ingested.

post.description: Queue the not-yet-imported messages of the selection, oldest first.
Fetch headers of every allowlisted message not indexed yet (idempotent).

get.description: New mail awaiting a decision: arrived after the sync point, not imported.

post.description: Look for new mail now (indexes headers only; imports nothing).

Skip the listed new mail: move the sync point to the newest of it.

Mail that arrives (or is indexed) later is still new. Nothing is imported or
deleted; the skipped mail stays available through Import history, and failed
messages are still retried.

get.description:
Today's briefing. The first request of the day starts generation and
returns ``processing``; the client polls until ``ready`` or ``failed``.

post.description: Regenerate today's briefing. A run already in flight is left alone.
Mark everything new as reviewed: advances last_home_visit to now.

get.description:
Overdue and upcoming deadlines, hearings, the caller's pending triage
bundles and overdue costs, each group counted in full and capped at five
rows.

delete.description: Delete an empty proceeding; the last proceeding of a case is refused.

Drop a relationship and remember the rejection so later detection runs
don't recreate it; reopens the target's thread if nothing confirmed remains.

post.description:
Promote an AI-detected relationship to user-confirmed; closes the target's thread.

Email-header edges are already facts about the mail — there is nothing to
confirm, and promoting one would turn a References-only link into a
thread-closing claim. They can still be rejected.

conversations and audit entries. Cases shared by others are not included.
Configuration only — no network probes (see /health and /models).
